host.description: Fully qualified domain name for Huginn, like 'huginn.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used by Huginn, like 'Europe/Berlin'. It is passed to the container both as TZ (operating system) and as TIMEZONE (Rails and the Huginn scheduler). An unknown name is rejected.

smtp_host.title: SMTP server
smtp_host.description: Mail relay host. Used only when no cluster smarthost is configured. Leave empty to disable manual mail settings.

smtp_port.title: SMTP port
smtp_port.description: Mail relay TCP port (commonly 587 for STARTTLS or 25).

smtp_username.title: SMTP username
smtp_username.description: Authentication user for the mail relay (optional).

smtp_password.title: SMTP password
smtp_password.description: Authentication password for the mail relay (optional); empty keeps the stored one.

smtp_starttls.title: SMTP STARTTLS
smtp_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS to encrypt the connection to the mail relay.

smtp_ssl_verify.title: Verify TLS certificate
smtp_ssl_verify.description: Verify the mail relay's TLS certificate. Disable for internal relays (e.g. the cluster smarthost) whose certificate is not valid for their address.

smtp_from.title: Sender address
smtp_from.description: From address used for outgoing mail. Defaults to huginn@<domain>.

enable_insecure_agents.title: Enable insecure agents
enable_insecure_agents.description: Unlock the ShellCommandAgent and LocalFileAgent, which can run arbitrary shell commands and read/write local files. Security risk: only enable on a trusted, single-tenant instance.

enable_second_precision_schedule.title: Enable second-precision schedules
enable_second_precision_schedule.description: Allow second-level fields in the SchedulerAgent cron expression. By default schedules are limited to minute precision.

invitation_code.title: Invitation code
invitation_code.description: Code required to register a new account. Prevents unwanted self-registration. Leave empty to keep the current code unchanged.

require_confirmed_email.title: Require confirmed email
require_confirmed_email.description: New users must confirm their email address before they can log in. Requires a working mail relay.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Global fallback API key for the built-in OpenAI agents; empty keeps the stored key.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI base URL
openai_base_url.description: API endpoint for the OpenAI agents. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Point it at a compatible endpoint (e.g. http://host:11434/v1 for Ollama).

delayed_job_max_runtime.title: Maximum job runtime (minutes)
delayed_job_max_runtime.description: An agent run taking longer is aborted (Huginn DELAYED_JOB_MAX_RUNTIME, upstream default 2).

delayed_job_sleep_delay.title: Worker poll interval (seconds)
delayed_job_sleep_delay.description: How long an idle worker sleeps before looking for new jobs (DELAYED_JOB_SLEEP_DELAY).

delayed_job_workers.title: Background workers
delayed_job_workers.description: Delayed Job workers running agents in parallel; each needs about 300 MB RAM.

healthcheck_mode.title: Automatic worker restart
healthcheck_mode.description: off; restart (the backlog is processed afterwards); quiet (drop the backlog and let the mail agents skip the events of the outage, no stale alarms).

healthcheck_mail_to.title: Report mail
healthcheck_mail_to.description: Optional address that gets a mail through the cluster smarthost after an automatic restart.
